_doc: Recycling & Circular Economy — recyclers, black mass, closed loop. Keyed by cleaned-name token; see ENRICHMENT_PROMPT.md.

li-cycle.one_liner: Spoke-and-hub Li-ion recycler producing black mass + battery-grade metals.

redwood materials.one_liner: Closed-loop recycler + cathode/anode-foil maker; founded by ex-Tesla CTO JB Straubel.

cirba solutions.one_liner: US battery-materials & recycling (formerly Retriev); Radix scrap-trading platform.

brunp.one_liner: CATL's recycling subsidiary; closed-loop cathode metals.

duesenfeld.one_liner: German Li-ion battery recycler using a mechanical (dry) process.

neometals.one_liner: Australian company recycling batteries via the Primobius joint venture with SMS group.

aqua metals.one_liner: US battery recycler using its AquaRefining electrochemical process.

zhejiang huayou.one_liner: Chinese cobalt and nickel refiner with a battery-recycling division.

green li-ion.one_liner: Direct-recycling technology licensor for lithium-ion battery materials.

onto technology.one_liner: US developer of direct cathode-recycling (relithiation) technology.

posco hy clean.one_liner: Korean battery-recycling joint venture affiliated with POSCO Holdings.

american battery technology.one_liner: US battery recycler and materials producer (formerly ABTC).

fortum.one_liner: Finnish energy company with a battery-recycling business.

ecobat.one_liner: US-headquartered battery recycler, historically the world's largest lead-acid recycler, expanding into lithium-ion.
